newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore port to detect oil slicks by satellite.
newsitem.headline: Singapore port to detect oil slicks by satellite.

text.p: The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) said on Wednesday it has signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to develop the use of satellites to detect oil slicks.
The two-year MOU was signed with the Centre for Remote Imaging, Sensing and Processing (CRISP) at the National University of Singapore (NUS), MPA said in a joint statement with NUS.
"Examples of projects in the pipeline include the use of satellite images to detect and monitor oil slicks on the ocean surface around Singapore," it said.
This will help control pollution in Singapore waters, it said.
MPA and CRISP will also look into using satellites images to detect vessel movements within port waters, the statement said.
